Workflows.title: Start a simulator session, verify the dashboard is usable, and view checking account activity
Workflows.goal: The dashboard page loads at /bank-sim/ and a welcome dialog is displayed; Heading 'Welcome to the NGPF Bank Simulator' is visible; The welcome dialog is no longer present and the dashboard content is visible; A non-empty checking account balance value is visible on the dashboard; The browser navigates to /bank-sim/account?type=checking; Account Activity heading is visible, Checking tab is present, the transaction table has Id/Date/Description/Amount/Balance column headers, and at least one transaction row is shown
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to the bank simulator home page and click GET STARTED NOW — The dashboard page loads at /bank-sim/ and a welcome dialog is displayed
2. Observe the welcome dialog heading is present — Heading 'Welcome to the NGPF Bank Simulator' is visible
3. Dismiss the welcome dialog by clicking Ok — The welcome dialog is no longer present and the dashboard content is visible
4. Verify the checking account balance is displayed on the dashboard — A non-empty checking account balance value is visible on the dashboard
5. Click VIEW ACCOUNT for the checking account — The browser navigates to /bank-sim/account?type=checking
6. Verify the account activity table is visible with transaction data for the checking account — Account Activity heading is visible, Checking tab is present, the transaction table has Id/Date/Description/Amount/Balance column headers, and at least one transaction row is shown
